parole.testo: Unknown. Theories include: * Simplified from *вьюла́ (*vʹjulá) from вить (vitʹ) * Related to юр (jur, “a spot stirred up by currents or bypassers etc.”), ю́ркий (júrkij, “agile, brisk”), Proto-Slavic *juriti (“to stir up”), Serbo-Croatian júriti (“to chivvy”), Polish jurzyć (“to stir up”), of Turkic
